subject.title: [Security] Session hijacking vulnerability due to predictable sequence IDs in gateway client

question: Does the gateway security owner confirm that event sequence numbers are non-secret ordering metadata and that this report demonstrates no gateway authentication or authorization bypass?
rationale: Source and documented protocol contracts contradict the proposed exploit, but protected security reports require explicit human disposition.

options.title: Close as non-exploitable
options.body: Confirm the existing authenticated WebSocket boundary and close unless private proof demonstrates unauthorized connection or RPC dispatch.

options.title: Request private exploit proof
options.body: Keep the issue open temporarily and request a packet-level reproduction showing a valid method executes without gateway credentials or authorized scopes.
